About Accenture: 
 Accenture is a leading global professional services company, providing a broad range of services and solutions in strategy, consulting, digital, technology and operations. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries and all business functions – underpinned by the world’s largest delivery network – Accenture works at the intersection of business and technology to help clients improve their performance and create sustainable value for their stakeholders. With more than 394,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries, Accenture drives innovation to improve the way the world works and lives. Visit us at  www.accenture.com .

 Accenture Strategy shapes our clients’ future, combining deep business insight with the understanding of how technology will impact industry and business models. Our focus on issues such as digital disruption, redefining competitiveness, operating and business models as well as the workforce of the future helps our clients find future value and growth in a digital world. Today, every business is a digital business. Digital is changing the way organizations engage with their employees, business partners, customers and communities how they manufacture and deliver products and services, and how they run their organizations. Approximately 3,000 consultants are part of this rapidly expanding network, providing specialized and strategic industry and functional consulting expertise from key locations around the world. title: Data Science Practitioner
desc:
Project Role : Data Science Practitioner
 Project Role Description : Formulating, design and deliver AI/ML-based decision-making frameworks and models for business outcomes. Measure and justify AI/ML based solution values. 
 Must have skills : Data Science
 Good to have skills : NA
Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required
 Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education

Summary: 
As a Data Science Practitioner, a typical day involves developing and implementing advanced decision-making frameworks and models that leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning techniques to drive meaningful business results. This role requires continuous evaluation of the effectiveness of these solutions, ensuring they align with organizational goals and deliver measurable value. Collaboration with various stakeholders to understand business challenges and translate them into analytical models is a key aspect of daily activities, along with refining and optimizing these models to enhance their performance and impact.
 
Roles & Responsibilities: 
- Expected to perform independently and become an SME.
- Required active participation/contribution in team discussions.
- Contribute in providing solutions to work related problems.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
- Continuously monitor and improve the performance of deployed models to ensure accuracy and reliability.
- Document methodologies, processes, and results to facilitate knowledge sharing and reproducibility.
- Support junior team members by providing guidance and sharing best practices.

Our product is heavy on Deep Learning, however lately we are also moving towards using LLMs to extract more feature information to improve quality of matching and leverage more data points for other purposes.

 Stack I assume you know: Azure, Databricks, Power BI, Deep Learning, Pyspark

 Senior and preferably even have experience in this domain 

 They need to be proactive and self sufficient
 
 
Professional & Technical Skills: 
- Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Data Science.
- Strong knowledge of machine learning algorithms and their practical applications.
- Experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering, and model evaluation techniques.
- Ability to work with large datasets and perform data analysis to extract actionable insights.
- Familiarity with programming languages commonly used in data science such as Python or R.
- Understanding of statistical concepts and their application in predictive modeling.
 
Additional Infor

As a Data Science Practitioner, you will be engaged in formulating, designing, and delivering AI and machine learning-based decision-making frameworks and models that drive business outcomes. Roles & Responsibilities: 
- Expected to be an SME.
- Collaborate and manage the team to perform.
- Responsible for team decisions.
- Engage with multiple teams and contribute on key decisions.
- Provide solutions to problems for their immediate team and across multiple teams.
- Facilitate knowledge sharing and mentorship within the team to enhance overall performance.
- Continuously evaluate and improve existing AI/ML models to ensure optimal performance and relevance.
 
Professional & Technical Skills: 
- Must To Have Skills: Proficiency in Data Science.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret complex data sets.
- Experience with programming languages such as Python or R for data analysis.
- Familiarity with machine learning frameworks and libraries, including TensorFlow or Scikit-learn.
- Knowledge of data visualization tools to effectively communicate insights.
 
Additional Information: 
- The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Data Science.
- This position is based at our Bengaluru office.
- A 15 years full time education is required.
